digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify CI workflow and change classification
propositions: Documentation-only changes must execute a reduced Verify lane with shared documentation gates instead of the full OS/Python matrix and mutation jobs
Routing decision must execute only from trusted origin/main using sparse checkout; patchset-controlled classifier logic and configuration must never execute or be imported
Classifier job failure must run every full-route job as fallback while still blocking Verified; empty, malformed, or parentless diffs must route to full Verify
Current inline documentation gates must be extracted into a single composite action and reused by both full and docs-only lanes without adding runner jobs
All documentation-related generated-doc, drift, index, cross-reference, quickstart, and validation gates must remain in the docs-only lane
Structural workflow consumers (test_gate_step_tree_skew.py, test_ci_workflow_parity.py, and seven others) must migrate to follow extracted gates without weakening invariants
